message.content: On April 5th, 2026, Li Hua proposed "Viva la Vida" as the jam session song. Wolfgang Schulz expressed enthusiasm for the song, stating it would be fun to play together. Yuriko Yamamoto also seemed excited about the idea, though she mentioned that they might need to prepare by practicing and listening to the track beforehand. Li Hua suggested getting together a bit earlier than usual to allow for some warm-up and practice runs through the song.
